name: ui-song-theme
description: The light palette combines silk-paper surfaces, warm ink text, Ru-celadon interactions, and cinnabar error states. The dark palette uses night-ink surfaces with a brighter celadon accent. Display headings prefer installed Song and CJK serif fonts; body text keeps the Harness sans-serif stack.
